description: Lists the Version Control Interface (VCI) workspaces of the open project, sorted by name: {name, group, rootPath, mappedObjects}. group is "" for the system group and a path such as G1/G2 for a workspace of a user group (nested groups are included). A workspace is a folder on the serve host that mirrors project objects as files, so that an external tool can version them. rootPath is null when the workspace has no root folder configured (tia_vci_status then answers 409 workspace_unconfigured); mappedObjects counts every mapped object of any kind. Only leaf objects (PLC blocks, PLC data types and tag tables) go through this tool set. A name shared by workspaces of several groups makes tia_vci_status, tia_vci_export and tia_vci_import answer 409 workspace_ambiguous, and an inventory that cannot be read completely is 409 vci_inventory_incomplete (nothing changed). Requires a connected project (409 not_connected); a TIA without VCI is 409 vci_unavailable. Maps to GET /vci/workspaces. Read-only (class R).
name: tia_vci_workspaces
title: TIA — VCI workspaces
